note: 0.3.1 player-killing zones. Inside a zone's rect (world tiles [x, y, w, h], top-left + size; y grows south) anyone may attack anyone (rules: track 'ai' / PK). The same rect is listed in data/combat_zones.json as multi-combat. biome 'scorch' turns the land to charred ash (tiles ash / ash_edge; edge_tiles rows of ash_edge mark the border). The HUD shows 'warning' as a banner the first time you cross in, then a chat line on later entries, and a skull label while inside. decor = per-tile chances for burnt trees, stumps and embers on ash ground.
